name: Discus (Symphysodon aequifasciatus)
description: Round-bodied Amazonian cichlid prized for its colour morphs; kept in groups of 4-8 to diffuse pair-bond aggression. Sensitive to dissolved organics and temperature swings — `fear.riskBaseline` bumped above the mid preset so they read as twitchier than the average community fish. Substring 'discus' fires the territory heuristic; we keep the cichlid default but lower aggression for the peaceful temperament.
